thread:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — noticed a big drop in active seats for SolunaCorp after their SSO cutover yesterday. 7-day DAU down ~62% vs baseline. tagging for triage.

analytics-bot: Automated report — SolunaCorp: active_users: 42 -> 16 (‑62%), last_error: login.fail.SSO (1204 occurrences), recent spikes at 14:32 PT. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/solunacorp/health
```
# sample query
SELECT count(distinct user_id) as dau
FROM events
WHERE account='solunacorp' AND event_time >= now() - interval '7 days';
```

Tom (Solutions Eng): Sounds like SSO handoff failures. Are errors 401 vs 500? If they're 5xx from IdP we can add retries and a short-circuit. I'll check logs and ping SRE.

Priya (Customer Ops): We're seeing users stuck on 'Redirecting...' after Okta. A lot of org admins can't complete login. Looping in our Okta admin now.

Lena (AE): Reminder — renewal in 6 weeks. Procurement already asked about a dedicated trial earlier this month; NimbusAI ran a pilot last week. Need to protect this account from churn.

Aisha (CSM): Action items: I'll send an admin outreach and offer a 2-week Dedicated trial + SSO assist. @Tom can you produce a short runbook for their admins we can paste into the outreach?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Yes. Quick workaround below — full runbook by EOD.
```
# workaround: force IdP session renewal for affected users
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/solunacorp/sso/retry \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"force": true}'
```
Will draft step-by-step admin fixes (whitelist callback IPs, check certificate validity).

Sam (Legal): If we're offering a Dedicated trial tied to SLA or capacity guarantees, we need sales/legal review before committing. @Lena please don't lock terms in customer comms.

Lena (AE): Got it. I'll coordinate messaging with procurement contact and avoid contractual language until Legal reviews.

Aisha (CSM): Scheduling a 30m admin screen-share with Priya tomorrow 11:00am PT to validate admin permissions and walk through the workaround. Checklist item: check for revoked app tokens & recent org-level policy changes. Anyone else to add?

Priya (Customer Ops): :thumbsup: Confirmed 11:00am. Also ask their Okta admin to whitelist our callback IPs and confirm the app's SAML cert hasn't rotated.

analytics-bot: I'll continue to monitor and will post an alert if DAU doesn't recover to >80% of baseline in the next 24h.
